headline: No new 10 AM outs found for your starters. Hockenson is still out, so add a TE before 10:00 AM Pacific, and add a QB before your QB's game.
alerts: Before 10:00 AM Pacific: T.J. Hockenson is OUT. Add a TE such as AJ Barner (SEA, 1:05 PM Pacific) and drop Seth McGowan or Germie Bernard.
You still need a QB. Add Aaron Rodgers (PIT at CIN, 5:20 PM Pacific) or another free QB before his game.
10 AM starters Breece Hall, Justin Jefferson, Matthew Golden and Spencer Shrader: no inactive reports found this run. Keep them in.
Garrett Wilson was reported clear to play for the Jets, so keep Adonai Mitchell on the bench.
This run could not open Sleeper or full inactive pages, so official 10 AM lists were not fully confirmed. Check the Sleeper app for any red OUT tags before 10:00 AM Pacific.
